90602.overview: A platformer loosely and humorously based on Journey to the West. Players take control of Sun Wukong.

126264.overview: This game is the sequel to and an improvement upon the Taiwanese game World Pro Baseball for the Mega Drive (itself a copycat of Power League '93 for the PC Engine) featuring fully licensed teams and players from Chinese Professional Baseball League.  It features big animations of certain plays and digitized samples of cheering crowds.

127745.overview: Super Dragon Force is a port of a Taiwanese DOS Strategy RPG very similar to Shining Force.  When brought to a console, the graphics were simplified but an overhead town exploration mode was created just for this version, making it even more similar to Shining Force.
